title: Certain of You, Lost in Us — No Script
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

successful_carousel_standard.rule: Build a public identity mirror with concrete couple receipts, active Zuv care, an emotional reversal, and a send/save thesis; stage the story in visible actions before choosing poster text; do not optimize for keywords.
successful_carousel_standard.open_reasoning_policy: Expose the real goal and selection logic; do not optimize for keywords or let slide copy substitute for staged story action.
successful_carousel_standard.prompt_rule: Prompts must prove relationship behavior through stage-scene Aachu/Zuv action; text completes the scene instead of carrying it.

human_truth: Commitment can choose the person without handing a couple a finished script for the life that follows.
emotional_arc: two people choose the same scene -> the stage fills with demands -> the script offers no instructions -> a missed cue stops feeling like a wrong choice -> they move into the next light together
source_story_summary: Commitment answers who we choose; shared life still asks how. Preserve the creator's exact six-slide copy and stage it as a dream-theatre where the same scene partner remains certain even when the script is blank.
visual_style: Poetic dream-theatre in Observational Intimacy Premium watercolor-and-ink; empty stage, overlapping spotlights, blank script, faded indigo curtain, exact copy and one tiny top-right brandmark; no blueprint, map, house-maze, random text, extra people, or yellow paper
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

story_selling_contract.rule: Begin concept thinking like an author: find the relationship obstacle, choose one process card, prove the feeling with Aachu/Zuv behavior, then score before writing slides or captions.

story_selling_decision.selected_concept_process_card: Card 20 - Saveable Lesson From One Scene
story_selling_decision.process_influence_summary: Card 20 supplies the saveable lesson; Card 07 keeps the ending inside imperfect real love.
story_selling_decision.selector_verdict: GO: the theatre route uses missed cues and resynchronization—not map substitution—to make certainty, visible failure and equal continuation readable before copy.

authorial_flow.relationship_obstacle: Commitment names the scene partner but cannot supply every next line, cue or position.

human_story_setup.cold_reader_doorway: The private recognition of being certain about a partner while the shared life still feels unwritten.
human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: Commitment names the scene partner but cannot supply every next line, cue or position.
human_story_setup.visible_human_proof: They keep walking together while the stage shifts, enter one shared light, each handle one practical pressure, find one blank script in blackout, laugh at a visible failed curtain cue, and each pull one chair into the next light.
human_story_setup.active_partner_role: Neither partner rescues the other. Both stay present, both recognize the failed cue, and both move one chair.
human_story_setup.emotional_turn: The failed scene becomes evidence of an unfinished process, not a wrong choice of partner.
human_story_setup.shareable_setup: Sendable to the person you remain sure about while both of you are still improvising the life around that certainty.
human_story_setup.earned_payoff: Commitment answered who; the next scene is still being learned through equal action.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer recognizes their own certainty-without-instructions and sends the deck to their partner.
success_definition.creative_success: The sequence reads silently through moving scenery, handled pressure, one blank-page blackout, a visibly failed cue, gaze and equal chair movement.
success_definition.brand_success: The route feels tender, specific and dream-real rather than like a generic theatre poster or quote card.
success_definition.production_success: Exact copy, actual Aachu/Zuv identity, one brandmark, 1080x1440 finals, structured visual QA and final audit all pass.

stage_scene_gate.action: They enter separate spotlights, absorb incoming adult-life scenery, search the same blank script, laugh together as the scene change visibly fails, then each drags one chair into the same next pool of light.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Their gazes meet, divide under pressure, converge on blank pages, reconnect at the mishap, and finally align toward one next cue.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention travels from mutual recognition to split demands, shared uncertainty, reciprocal recognition, and one shared forward focus.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Hands remain self-owned and simple: separate arrival, self-contained pressure gestures, no hands at the blank-page conflict, one resting hand each at the turn, and one clearly owned chair pull each at payoff.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The blackout and completely blank script hold the quiet pause in which love is present but not instructional.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The script is closed and left behind; the chairs move from opposite wings toward one shared cue.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: A failed scene stops reading as a wrong scene partner; they actively take their separate seats into the next light.
